description:
Bowe Property are delighted to present to the market, Valley View, Curraghcrowley, Ballineen. Set on a wonderful, private, elevated setting overlooking the surrounding countryside of Enniskeane and Ballineen and its rich agricultural hinterlands, this is a wonderful private property, set on approximately 5 acres, with a long, tree lined approach to an elevated setting with an exceptional private and mature setting. The main residence is a traditional three bay, two storey farmhouse with a barn conversion extension, and the property is benefited by a sympathetic and very impressive renovation and refurbishment. With extensive accommodation consisting of four bedrooms, three bathrooms, two reception rooms, home office, a wonderful kitchen/dining room with a complimenting utility area. In addition, a detached stone-built cottage lies adjacent to the main residence, which has been sympathetically restored to a habitable condition with further use potential. A large storage corrugated shed offers enormous versatile space for stables, secure storage, and a host of other potential uses. The property's 5 acres consist of woodlands with native trees, grass paddocks, secret gardens, and much more. A former detached outbuilding has been repurposed as a gym and offers further versatile space, but it is the property's setting within 2km of Ballineen and Enniskeane Villages, 14km off Clonakilty, and 18km off Bandon Town, with its elevated and private setting, that sets this property apart as a most unique traditional small landholding with two traditional houses and two storey cottage. For those seeking privacy, convenience with a property with huge versatility, charm, and absolute beauty in terms of its setting and outlook, will find Curraghcrowley a difficult prospect to ignore. Viewing comes highly recommended, and the property has to be viewed to truly appreciate its entire setting offering.
Viewings are now openly invited and are strictly by prior appointment.

features: Character filled traditional farmhouse and cottage with outbuildings.
5 acres of paddocks woodlands with exquisite views.
Close to Ballineen, Enniskeane and Clonakilty.
Versatile property with further potential (detached cottage).
A short walking distance of 2km to Ballineen Village.
The main house has been substantially renovated over the years while keeping the feel and character of the original farmhouse.
The range of sheds and outbuildings gives plenty of flexibility for storage, animals, hobbies or other uses.
The cottage is a proper part of the property in its own right and provides very useful additional accommodation.
The long entrance and mature trees give the property a great sense of privacy on arrival.
